observacoes: Converted from hsl in src/styles.css (@theme): brand-navy hsl(202 100% 25%) = #005180 (--primary and page background), brand-blue hsl(196 100% 41%) = #0099d1 (ring, number balloon), brand-yellow hsl(46 100% 50%) = #ffc300 (CTA button, number 20789), brand-green hsl(80 100% 40%) = #88cc00 ('Deputado Estadual' kicker), brand-orange #ff6a00, off-white #f3f5f6. The card-juliano-lopes card states: blue #005D8B, light blue #00A7F5, yellow #FEC800. Fonts: Duera (custom TTF in public/fonts; DueraCond Bold for titles, Duera for text). Logos (transparent; the first two converted from WebP): logo-juliano-lopes.png ('Professor Juliano Lopes Deputado Estadual' in navy and light blue, for light backgrounds), logo-juliano-lopes-branco.png (white, for the navy background) and logo-juliano-lopes-horizontal.png (navy, with @professorjulianolopes, for light backgrounds). The logo does not include the number 20789.
